title: The Ravensgate Interlock
tagline: A storm, a dam, two deaths. The file says murder-suicide.
hook: A storm cuts the road to a hydroelectric dam and seals six people in with each other. By dawn two are dead: a manager electrocuted at a switchgear cabinet, and a control engineer drowned in the intake gallery. Her credential card opened his cabinet and closed the circuit that killed him. The police found murder-suicide and closed the file in nineteen days.
note: Play Case 01 first. This one opens with a crime already solved.
advice: Four of these twelve return nothing you do not already have. They are not traps; they are the ordinary shape of an investigation. Before you spend, point at the document that made you want it. If you cannot, read further first.

documents.title: Statement: H. Vey, Shift Control Engineer

persons.label: Persons
persons.hint: Record a finding for every person, with the evidence you rely on. The original finding named Ines Ballard.

accusation.question: The deaths of Aurelio Sarn and Ines Ballard are found to be...

options.label: Murder-suicide, as originally found
options.sub: Ines Ballard killed Aurelio Sarn, then drowned herself.

Double unlawful killing by Dessa Okonkwo

phases.prompt: Which of the two deaths came first, and why do you think so?
Give a time window for Ines Ballard entering the water.
Who could have been at console 1 at 06:02?
Where was her credential card, and who could reach it?

rules: The documents don't lie. People might. If a statement and a log disagree, the log is right.
The file opens in five phases: the Case Board first, then one Specialist File at a time. Write your hypothesis at each gate before you open the next.
Authorities open from Phase 2. You have a fixed number and they do not come back. Four of the twelve return nothing new.
Resolution Sheet steps score double if you establish them before the last phase opens, while the file is still in pieces.
Write your working with document references as you go. Anything not written before the final accusation scores nothing.
Two wrong accusations are permitted; each costs 10 points and opens a Reconsider envelope. Upholding the original finding counts as an accusation. The third is final.

printKit.envelopes: 17 envelopes: 12 numbered 01-12, 4 marked RECONSIDER, 1 marked S-1. Plus clips for the five file bundles.

files.name: 01 Case Board
files.what: Public. Lives in the middle of the table all game.

files.name: 02 Specialist Files
files.what: Split into five bundles at pages 1-4 / 5-8 / 9-12 / 13-16 / 17-20. One per detective.

files.name: 03 Play materials
files.what: Briefing, Conference rules, Authority menu, Resolution Sheet.

files.name: 04 Authority results
files.what: Separate without reading. One page per envelope, numbered 01-12.

files.name: 05 Reconsider and Envelope S-1
files.what: Pages 1-4 seal separately (Reconsider). Pages 5-9 seal together (S-1).

checklist: Print the Player pack single-sided, plus spares of both SCADA (D-1) pages
Split the Specialist Files into five bundles (pages 1-4, 5-8, 9-12, 13-16, 17-20) and clip each
Someone who is NOT playing prints the Sealed pack face-down
Put Authority results 01-12 in 12 numbered envelopes, one page each, unread
Seal the 4 Reconsider inserts separately (Ballard, Okonkwo, Wrenn, Mbeki)
Seal the 5 pages of Envelope S-1 together, cover facing out
Hand out the file bundles face down; nobody opens one until the briefing is read

steps: Only one of the two deaths has a clock. The other has to be dated by something other than a body.
Re-read the referral (A-0). Ask how a body could possibly reach the intake gallery.
The gallery only fills while intake gate 2 is open (D-2A), and D-1 section 2 gives the gate times: 02:31 to 03:12.

hints.q: Her card closed the circuit. So she did it?
steps: A credential event records a card. It does not record a person.
Where was her card when she was found? Compare D-2 (the recovery) with C-5A (credential practice).
Authority 02, the property and credential audit, says exactly where her card was recovered.

hints.q: Why did a correct lockout kill Sarn?
steps: He locked out the circuit he knew about.
E-6 asks a question about the as-built drawing. E-2A says what contract RG-0419 was supposed to remove.
Authority 07 shows who amended the drawing, and when.

hints.q: Who could have used her card?
steps: Her card was used at a console. Who was in that room, and for how long?
E-1 shows the control room door did not open between 02:29 and 05:44.
A session log shows that a session is open, not that anyone is in the chair. Authority 01 checks the chair.

hints.q: How do I clear Piotr Wrenn?
steps: You need him accounted for in three windows: while the gate was open, at 06:02, and whenever he was last in the control room.

scoring.doubleLabel: Established before the last phase opened
